statement: Pinned rnconrad wiimote.c emits a queued read-result (input report 0x21) with error code 8 for an out-of-range guest EEPROM write (lines 299-307). Dolphin's WriteData handler instead returns an ACK (input report 0x22) containing InvalidAddress for the equivalent error (EmuSubroutines.cpp lines 280-283 and 321-322). This conflicts at the output report type, regardless of the shared error number, and is not resolved as retail behavior.

applicability.revision: Historical independent software emulators, not physical hardware revisions
applicability.scope: Historical device-side implementation disagreement for write-error response routing; rnconrad source lines 299-307 and Dolphin EmuSubroutines.cpp 280-283,321-322. Conflict with wii-c5-memory-errors to be linked after PR #16 merges, without modifying its pending files now.
